name: Create user
description: Registers a user DID at this venue. Venue administrators may supply any valid DID, or a username to derive did:web:<venue>:u:<username>. Idempotent: created is false when already registered.

did.description: Any valid DID, including a self-sovereign did:key or an externally managed DID

username.description: Venue-managed username; requires a public venue hostname and becomes did:web:<venue>:u:<username>

authenticationKeys.description: Optional initial public did:key authenticators for a venue-managed username
